bibl.title: The Construction of P.Bodmer VIII and the Bodmer "Composite" or "Miscellaneous" Codex.
bibl.seg: Brent Nongbri, The Construction of P.Bodmer VIII and the Bodmer "Composite" or "Miscellaneous" Codex.
bibl.note: The material remains are not inconsistent with P. Bodmer VIII having been 1) copied as the first tractate in an earlier codex, 2) removed from its original codex, 3) bound to other texts in the Bodmer composite codex (= LDAB 2565) using a link-stitch technique, and finally 4) repaired along with the rest of the composite codex using the stabbing method.
